subject.title: memory_search: chokidar file watcher silently stops delivering events, index goes stale

question: Should OpenClaw make memorySearch.sync.intervalMinutes non-zero by default as the safety net for silent watcher loss, or keep the default opt-in and fix this through watcher health/self-healing only?
rationale: The source-backed bug is real, but the currently proposed fix changes default background indexing behavior for existing users, which repository policy treats as product and compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Adopt default interval fallback
options.body: Resolve and review the linked PR or an equivalent patch that defaults periodic memory sync on while preserving intervalMinutes: 0 as an explicit opt-out.

options.title: Keep interval opt-in
options.body: Fix watcher liveness or recovery without changing the default interval, accepting that silent watcher loss must be detected through that path instead.

options.title: Defer pending live outage proof
options.body: Leave the issue open without merging a default change until a multi-hour live gateway reproduction confirms the exact watcher failure mode.

recommendation.title: Adopt default interval fallback
recommendation.body: Resolve and review the linked PR or an equivalent patch that defaults periodic memory sync on while preserving intervalMinutes: 0 as an explicit opt-out.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest memory subsystem history and is best positioned to choose the durable memory/defaults boundary.
